modern_card.name: Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV4

effective.basis: Old state: UDE official card rulings (Sangan/Witch: 'If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify', captured 2005-06-16) through Konami's own per-set rulings documents - Machina Mayhem (2010-04-06, 18 days before the Edison snapshot), Starstrike Blast (2010-11-16), Storm of Ragnarok (2011-02-02). New state: KDE-US Tournament Policy section 'Card/Hand/Deck Verification' forbids verifying the opponent's Deck (first located capture 2019-04-03; still current in v2.5, 2025-09-05). No dated announcement of the change was found, so the interval 2011-02-02 .. 2019-04-03 stays open.

changes.historical_text: As long as this card remains face-up on your side of the field, control of this card cannot switch. During the End Phase of a turn that this card destroyed a monster as a result of battle, send this card to the Graveyard to Special Summon 1 "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" from your hand or Deck.
changes.summary: Period procedure, not a text erratum: when the GOAT script's s.spop finds no "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" in hand or Deck it reveals both zones to prove the whiff (else-branch Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_DECK)); the modern script never reveals. No lineage version carries reveal wording.

changes.historical_text: As long as this card remains face-up on your side of the field, control of this card cannot switch. During the End Phase of a turn that this card destroyed a monster as a result of battle, send this card to the Graveyard to Special Summon 1 "Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV6" from your hand or Deck.
changes.summary: Era activation semantics, separate from the verification procedure: the GOAT s.sptg keeps only the free-zone test (ft>0) and drops the modern script's Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.spfilter,tp,LOCATION_HAND|LOCATION_DECK,...), so the End Phase effect can be activated - sending this face-up Horus to the Graveyard as cost - with no LV6 available to Special Summon. Nothing in the packet dates the end of this per-card allowance, so its chronology is unresolved.

review.notes: Baseline text matches lineage v0 (SOD-EN006, Soul of the Duelist, 2004-10-01) exactly - the first printing and the text in force at the GOAT snapshot. Trailing lineage is cosmetic: v1 (DR3-EN006, 2006-11-25) contracts the control-lock clause and restates the cost as "by sending this card to the Graveyard"; v2 (LCYW-EN197, 2012-09-29) is PSCT ("You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; Special Summon ..."). The optionality the PSCT "You can" makes explicit is already how both scripts register the effect, and the level-up self-send remains a cost in both. Remaining diffs are refactors: the GOAT copy hand-rolls s.spcost (IsAbleToGraveAsCost / Duel.SendtoGrave(REASON_COST)) where modern calls Cost.SelfToGrave, spells RESETS_STANDARD_PHASE_END out as RESET_EVENT+RESETS_STANDARD+RESET_PHASE+PHASE_END, and substitutes 0x3 for SET_HORUS_BLACK_FLAME_DRAGON. Upstream ships one GOAT script encoding both ruling behaviours, so no implementation exists for a state in which only one had changed, and with (B) undated the pair cannot be sequenced. Not listed on EdisonFormat.com's Functional Errata page.
